name: Skilled Kenninger
body:
You are a master of the art of kenning, of subtly creating oral allusions to common objects.

Prerequisite(s): Perform (oratory) 2 ranks, bardic performance class feature

Benefit(s): You may add half your ranks in Profession (oratory) to the DC to resist your bardic music.
